name: Code mode
note: Model writes code that calls tools
summary: Instead of calling tools one at a time through function calling, the model writes a short program against a typed API generated from the tools, and that program runs in a sandbox. Intermediate results stay in the sandbox, so only the final output returns to the model's context. Cloudflare named the approach Code Mode in September 2025, and Anthropic described the same idea for MCP in November 2025.
how: Convert tool or MCP schemas into a typed code API (e.g. TypeScript)
Give the model one tool: run code
Execute the code in an isolated sandbox with bindings to the real tools
Return only what the code logs or returns to the model
facts: Cloudflare uses V8 isolates via the Worker Loader API
Fewer tokens and round trips, but needs a secure code sandbox
goodFor: Chaining several tool calls without passing data through the model
Filtering large tool results before they reach context
watchOut: Running model-written code needs real sandboxing
Adds infrastructure compared with plain tool calls
Errors surface as code failures, which can be harder to trace
